_comment: Accounts used by the end-to-end suite. These are TEST credentials for a
disposable database created by e2e/prepare-db.sh and the CI e2e job — they are
seeded into the E2E database only, and are never the production passwords.
e2e/prepare-db.sh exports the same strings as SBDMA_<ROLE>_PASSWORD before it
runs `python -m app.seed`, so the seeder and the browser agree on one source.
